'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] marries political activist [[Carrie Symonds]] in a private ceremony at [[Westminster Cathedral]]. Approximately 30 people were in attendance. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-57296472 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The number of people found dead following [[list of shipwrecks in 2021|a boat accident]] in [[Kebbi State]], [[Nigeria]], three days ago, increases to 76. Many more people are still missing. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/464456-kebbi-boat-mishap-76-corpses-recovered-so-far-governor.html (The Premium Times)]
*Seven people, including actor [[Joe Lara]] and his wife [[Gwen Shamblin Lara]], are killed in a plane crash in [[Smyrna, Tennessee]]. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/nation-world/ct-aud-ent-tarzan-actor-joe-lara-tennesee-plane-crash-20210530-6skwpu6lgvdcrhzjpuuugwvkae-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 9,020 new cases of [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 558,534. The country also reports a record 98 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 2,650. [https://www.thevibes.com/articles/news/29112/new-day-new-high-msia-logs-another-9020-covid-19-cases (''The Vibes'')] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysian-business-groups-urge-quicker-release-of-details-on-essential-sectors (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports a record 21 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 99. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4212549 (Taiwan News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] discovers a new [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|variant]] of [[SARS-CoV-2]] that combines the mutations from [[Lineage B.1.617]] and [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/coronavirus-vietnam-variant-kent-india-b1856261.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Catherine, Duchess of Cambridge]] receives her first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-duchess-of-cambridge-posts-picture-of-her-first-coronavirus-vaccine-12320046 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States]] reports nearly 11,976 new cases of [[COVID-19]], the lowest in the country since March 23, 2020. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/30/us-covid-cases-lowest-in-a-year-as-memorial-day-travel-picks-up.html (CNBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]], [[Spratly Islands dispute]]
**The [[Department of Foreign Affairs (Philippines)|Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs]] files a diplomatic complaint against [[China]] for the continued presence of Chinese maritime and fishing vessels near [[Thitu Island]], making this the 84th diplomatic complaint the [[Philippines]] has filed against China since the start of [[Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte|Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte's administration]] in 2016. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/29/philippines-protests-chinas-illegal-south-china-sea-presence (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A car explodes outside an apartment block in [[Arad, Romania]]. The driver, Ioan Crișan, a well-known fish farmer and businessman, was killed, and several windows were shattered. The authorities suspect foul play. [https://www.g4media.ro/update-serviciul-roman-de-informatii-participa-la-ancheta-din-arad-patronul-unei-firme-piscicole-si-fostul-socru-al-deputatului-pnl-sergiu-bilcea-a-murit-dupa-ce-masina-a-explodat-imediat-dupa-pornir.html (''G4 Media'')]
*A major [[Austria]]n [[Islam in Austria|Muslim]] organization files a lawsuit against [[Second Kurz government|the government]] for publishing a map on Thursday listing the location of the country's mosques and Islamic associations, saying it "represents an unprecedented crossing of boundaries". The Islamic Religious Community in Austria, the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Turkey)|Turkish Foreign Ministry]], and members of the ruling [[The Greens – The Green Alternative|Green Party]] have also criticized the map's publication. [https://www.dw.com/en/austrias-muslim-youth-file-lawsuit-against-islam-map/a-57712058 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[International protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]	
**In the [[United Kingdom]], protesters gather in [[Birmingham]] and [[Manchester]] to show solidarity with [[State of Palestine|Palestine]]. In Manchester, protesters gather at the [[BBC]] building in [[MediaCityUK]], while protesters burn [[Flag of Israel|Israeli flags]] in Birmingham. [https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/greater-manchester-news/free-palestine-protestors-climb-bbc-20706549 (''Manchester Evening News'')] [https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/news/midlands-news/israeli-flags-burnt-palestine-protests-20706925 (''Birmingham Mail'')]	
**In [[Washington, D.C.]] protesters gather at the [[Lincoln Memorial]] to call for an end to [[Israel–United States relations#United States aid|aid from the United States]] to [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/pro-palestinian-rally-in-washington-seeks-end-to-us-aid-to-israel/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[2021 Brazilian protests]]
**[[Brazil]]ian social movements organize demonstrations in Brazil's major cities against the government of [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]. Protestors demand Bolsonaro's [[impeachment]] over the perceived mishandling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil|COVID-19 pandemic]] by the government, with calls for faster and wider [[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil|vaccination campaigns]]. [https://theguardian.com/world/2021/may/29/tens-of-thousands-of-brazilians-march-to-demand-bolsonaros-impeachment (The Guardian)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A team at [[Cardiff University]] has created the first 3D replica of a spin-ice material that allows for the generation of [[magnetic monopoles]]-like quasi-particles. Magnetic force microscopy was then used to visualize the magnetic charges present on the device, allowing the team to track the movement of the single-pole magnets across the 3D structure. [https://phys.org/news/2021-05-breakthrough-3d-magnetic-nanostructures-modern-day.html (Phys.org)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 English Football League play-offs]]
**[[Brentford F.C.]] defeat [[Swansea City A.F.C.]] 2–0 in the [[2021 EFL Championship play-off Final]] at [[Wembley Stadium]], securing promotion to the [[2021–22 Premier League]] after a 74-year absence from the top flight of English football. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/57215919 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2020–21 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] defeat [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] 1–0 in the [[2021 UEFA Champions League Final|final]] at the [[Estádio do Dragão]] in [[Porto]], Portugal, to win their second [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] title. [https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/champions-league-final-score-chelsea-upset-manchester-city-on-havertz-goal-christian-pulisic-makes-history/live/ (CBS Sports)]
